title: Troubleshooting index
summary: Find the fix for what you are seeing: every symptom-first article in the help centre, grouped by access, set-up, messaging, displays, mobile sites and queueing.
bodyMd:
This index lists every symptom the help centre has a fix for. Find the line that matches what you see and follow its link; each destination gives the cause and the fix.

Access and sign-in

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
The login page rejects your email address or passwordWrong login page (HQ Admin vs Retail Admin), unregistered address, or an expired 24-hour invitation linkI can't sign in to the platform
An Access Denied page instead of the login pageYour IP address is not on the platform's allowed list, or your CDN blocked the requestI see an Access Denied error
A new HQ user never received their invitation emailThe platform email address is not yet Verified, or AWS SES is still in sandbox modeAdd HQ Admin, Marketing and Helpdesk users
A store staff member cannot sign in to Retail AdminAccount not in the uploaded CSV, or the wrong first-time passwordSign in to the Retail Admin site (no SAML/SSO)

Installation and set-up

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
Verify Domain keeps failingThe CNAME records have not propagated or were entered against the wrong hostStep 3 — Set up DNS after installation
The certificate countdown reached zero before DNS was liveThe 3-day AWS certificate expired; support has to reissue itStep 3 — Set up DNS after installation
The CloudFormation stack or installer fails, or the platform does not load after installationStack parameters, AWS permissions or environment sizeAWS deployment: testing and troubleshooting
Searching for a store when adding it returns nothingNo valid Google Maps API key under Platform Admin → Google Maps/PlacesAdding a store finds nothing in Google Places
Retail Admin shows a page titled "The Unicorns have gone on Strike"The page address is wrong; it is the platform's 404 pageUse the left navigation instead, for example Update your store's opening hours (Retail Admin)

SMS and email

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
Visitors do not receive SMS messages, or messages arrive from "UNVERIFIED"AWS account still in SMS sandbox mode, or the SMS sender ID is not registered or is restrictedSMS messages are not sent or arrive as UNVERIFIED
SMS messages come from your brand name rather than the sender ID you expectedThe default sender is ${BrandName}Update the platform's SMS sender ID
A visitor did not get a specific queue or appointment messageThat template is switched off under Shared SettingsSMS and email messages sent to visitors

Displays and devices

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
A display shows a red status dot, "Offline", or "This device is disconnected"The device lost power or networkA display shows as offline
You want to know how long a display has been offline—View a display's status and time offline
Nobody was told a display went offlineNo offline device notification is set upGet notified when a display goes offline
A display shows the "Playback issues" icon, or a campaign is not playing on itThe campaign stopped playing; the Playback Audit shows whenIdentify campaign playback issues on a display
You need the event history for a display (offline periods, orientation changes)—View a display's log history
Retail Admin shows "Seems like you are experiencing a Store Wide Internet issue. Contact Admin."Every display in the store is offline at once, which points to the store's connectionA display shows as offline
A new device does not appear under Unassigned DevicesThe device has not reached the registration screen, or digital signage is not enabledRegister a new display or device

Mobile store sites and campaigns

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
A mobile site menu item or campaign URL loads a blank pageThe destination site's content security policy blocks embeddingMy mobile site shows a blank page
The AI assistant does not write a brief from your description, or storyboard, creative or video generation failsNo integration or an invalid API key under Platform Admin → AI Models / Integrations, or no video model (Veo 3.1 or LTX 2.5) registeredConnect AI models and providers
A campaign shows "Not Running" or "Not Activated"The campaign is not activated, or has no schedule that is currently liveActivate or deactivate a campaign

Queueing and appointments

What you seeMost likely causeArticle
Retail Admin shows "Lost Connection to Queueing Server!"The tablet's connection to the queueing service droppedRetail Admin shows 'Lost Connection to Queueing Server!'
A visitor is stuck in the queue from a previous dayStaff did not finish serving themRemove a visitor from the queue

Still stuck?

Email support@personalisationhub.com with your platform domain, the environment, what you selected, and what you saw — see How do I get support?.
